chunks: "Grant me respite," said he, "till the raising of the dead."
ai.seo_question: What did the disbeliever ask for in exchange for belief?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is often interpreted as the quintessential expression of 'delayed repentance' (takhir al-tawba), where the disbeliever assumes a final opportunity for faith will be granted at the moment of death or resurrection. It underscores the theological principle that the time for sincere conversion is now, as the 'delay' requested is ultimately denied when the soul reaches the throat. This narrative serves as a warning against procrastination in spiritual duties, a theme frequently cited by Imams to encourage immediate adherence to divine commands.
